lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular clusters organized into vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a coordinate-like grid across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear horizontal features running across the upper third of the flank, displaying a transition from light pixels to shadow, defining longitudinal ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense population of micro-scale high-luminance spots on the anterior cranial region and the distal surface of the pectoral fin.
